_comment: Recorded acceptance-case grades for the GAP-004 external-input real-input fixtures and the corpus denominator. Written by the 2026-09-26 GAP-004 job; parity/coverage-map.json reads this file (never the reverse). Every grade below was executed in the recorded run; nothing here is carried from prose.

environment.note: the browser binary was loaded from a PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH exec-mounted volume because this host mounts /tmp noexec; the launch arguments themselves are unchanged

media_image.command: node parity/render-batch.mjs media_image --dual  (same-pass golden via vendored WebGL2Backend + BabylonBackend candidate, one page) then parity/.venv/bin/python parity/compare.py parity/out/media_image.golden.png parity/out/media_image.candidate.png --name media_image --tolerance 0 --ssim-min 0.999
media_image.fixture: deterministic 161x97 putImageData host image uploaded via backend.updateTextureFromSource(imageTex_step_0, canvas, {flipY:false}) + pipeline.setUniform('imageSize',[161,97]) — the real media input path, both backends

text_glyphs.command: node parity/render-batch.mjs text_glyphs --dual  then  parity/.venv/bin/python parity/compare.py parity/out/text_glyphs.golden.png parity/out/text_glyphs.candidate.png --name text_glyphs --tolerance 0 --ssim-min 0.999
text_glyphs.fixture: deterministic output-sized (256x256) putImageData overlay canvas uploaded via backend.updateTextureFromSource(textTex_step_1, canvas, {flipY:true}) — the real text input path, both backends. The DSL pins text(matteColor:, color:) numerically: the raw-Pipeline harness receives string color DEFAULTS ('#000000') which _setUniform feeds to uniform3fv as NaN (the noisedeck host converts color defaults through its program-state layer); explicit DSL color args are compiler-converted to numeric vec4

roll_midi.command: node parity/render-batch.mjs roll_midi --dual  then  parity/.venv/bin/python parity/compare.py parity/out/roll_midi.golden.png parity/out/roll_midi.candidate.png --name roll_midi --tolerance 0 --ssim-min 0.999
roll_midi.fixture: the engine's own exported MidiState (deterministic noteOn events on channels 1/2/9, clockCount 96) attached via pipeline.setMidiState; the engine uploads the resulting noteGrid through backend.uploadDataTexture('midiNoteGrid', ...) every frame — the real MIDI path, no stub. Output verified distinct from the committed no-input fallback golden

mesh_obj.command: node parity/render-batch.mjs mesh_obj --dual  then  parity/.venv/bin/python parity/compare.py parity/out/mesh_obj.golden.png parity/out/mesh_obj.candidate.png --name mesh_obj --tolerance 0 --ssim-min 0.999
mesh_obj.fixture: deterministic unit-cube OBJ text parsed+packed by the ENGINE's own CanvasRenderer.loadOBJFromString (internal parseOBJ/packMeshDataForTextures) and uploaded through backend.uploadMeshData — the real host OBJ-load path. This required implementing BabylonBackend.uploadMeshData (+_uploadMeshTexture, mirroring webgl2.js) in this job

historicalDenominator.status: historical (STATUS.md corpus section, v1.0.181-era artifact); counts retained unchanged
historicalDenominator.reason: raw/ is a local-only gitignored fixture set by policy; the historical raw inputs are absent from this checkout, so the historical 39+1 grade cannot be re-executed here

freshLiveFeed.command: bash parity/corpus/fetch.sh (RSS + sharing.noisedeck.app API, 20/20 saved) then reference-compiler classification of each raw composition via tools/export-fat-graph.mjs (20 compile, 0 rejected)

reGradeExclusion.reason: each corpus composition requires a same-pass 1800-frame (~30 s) golden+candidate evolution pair per parity/corpus/sweep.sh; one dual-minted composition exceeded this container's stable-browser budget (SwiftShader headless session >420 s for a single composition), so the 20-composition re-grade was not executed here. Completing it requires a stable runner (the recorded container limitation for full-roster sweeps, see STATUS.md known limits).
reGradeExclusion.requiredFixture: parity/corpus/raw inputs + a stable long-session browser runner
